scope: Binance BTCUSDT spot, long or cash, no leverage

model.pool: one USDT pool; an armed sleeve buys pool / sleeves holding nothing after the open exits; each sleeve exits and stops on its own coins
model.stop_order: STOP_LOSS stopPrice amended as the daily high ratchets

execution.entry_preview: One MARKET buy by quoteOrderQty at the next open for the sleeves armed by an ordinary entry or a crash reversal. Each armed sleeve spends the free USDT plus the estimated proceeds of that open's exits, divided by the sleeves that hold nothing after those exits. When both signals are armed for a sleeve the preview is the crash reversal, because that fill is a repair hold. Not submitted
execution.exit_preview: One MARKET sell on the next open for the sleeves with a blow-off, an adverse close, or a close that is no longer above their SMA. A repair hold does not sell for those reasons.
execution.protection_preview: One STOP_LOSS sell per held sleeve. An entry preview, before the fill, uses a stopPrice 28% under the completed close. A hold with no recorded fill uses that close. A followed fill starts the stop at the fill. During repair the stop is 28% under the high since that fill. Not submitted. When the distance is outside the sell band and trailingDelta, the preview marks the stop not placeable and does not add a limit price. The meter peak starts at the fill open.
execution.followed_fill: A later BTC balance is recorded only when the previous preview was an entry and account trades explain the coins. Sleeves previewed on one signal day share the fill equally. A balance drop is recorded only when account sells leave exactly the coins of recorded sleeves. Anything else at or above 5 USDT is unknown.
execution.adverse_exit: next open; the loss is not capped at 4%
execution.path_convention: stop from the prior completed peak; the bar high tightens the stop for the next day; end-of-day CNY enters the drawdown. Under this timing the registered P3 account and the P4 final CNY, CAGR, and MDD are unchanged
execution.cold_start: the session and the forward ledger both call note_flat at the start: an already bullish regime waits for a fresh cross
execution.execute: blocked before config, credentials, and network because qualification is NOT_QUALIFIED
